title: GitHub ML & AI Repositories (2026 Snapshot)
subtitle: 7,550 real repos with 500+ stars across 20 ML/AI topics
description:
Every machine learning and AI repository on GitHub with at least 500 stars across 20 topics (machine-learning, deep-learning, llm, ai-agents, rag, computer-vision, nlp, reinforcement-learning, mlops, diffusion-models and more), pulled from GitHub's public search API on 2026-10-01. Real data, not generated.

Each row is one repository: stars, forks, open issues, size, primary language, license, full topic list, which searched topics matched it, creation and last-push dates, archived and fork flags, and derived age and staleness in days.

Useful for studying where open-source AI attention goes, how the field shifted toward LLM agents and TypeScript, how many popular projects are still maintained, and what you can legally build on. GitHub search returns at most 1,000 results per query, so the five largest topics are capped at their 1,000 most-starred repos; per-topic counts are lower bounds.

Repository metadata comes from GitHub's public API; descriptions belong to their authors. Use is subject to GitHub's Terms of Service. The collection script is included so the snapshot can be repeated.
